conditional-promise-and-willingness.speaker: Ava
conditional-promise-and-willingness.text: If finance approves, I will send the revised budget to Nora by Thursday.

conditional-promise-and-willingness.speaker: Ben
conditional-promise-and-willingness.text: I can draft the launch announcement if that would help.

conditional-promise-and-willingness.speaker: Nora
conditional-promise-and-willingness.text: Thanks, Ben, but let us leave the announcement unassigned for now.

conditional-promise-and-willingness.speaker: Ava
conditional-promise-and-willingness.text: My budget promise still depends on finance approval; it is not an unconditional send.

accepted-request-owner.speaker: Priya
accepted-request-owner.text: Mateo, could you send the accessibility report to Jules by Tuesday?

accepted-request-owner.speaker: Jules
accepted-request-owner.text: Tuesday works for receiving it. I am the recipient, not the person preparing or sending it.

accepted-request-owner.speaker: Mateo
accepted-request-owner.text: Yes, I will take that on and send it by Tuesday.

accepted-request-owner.speaker: Priya
accepted-request-owner.text: Thanks, Mateo. That is the only follow-up from this discussion.

withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.speaker: Ava
withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.text: I will send the integration checklist to Ben by Friday.

withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.speaker: Ben
withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.text: If legal approves, I can draft the announcement.

withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.speaker: Casey
withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.text: Next quarter the team may explore a migration, but that is not a current commitment.

withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.speaker: Dana
withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.text: The research discussion has no assignments or decisions today.

withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.speaker: Ava
withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.text: I take back my earlier checklist commitment. The source data is incomplete, so no one should send it Friday.

withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.speaker: Dana
withdrawal-and-qualified-promise.text: After the final audit, I will publish the reviewed FAQ to Elena by Wednesday.
